summary: Open-source AI coding agent for VS Code, JetBrains and the terminal, with Code, Plan, Ask and Debug modes and access to 500+ models.

heroCommands.command: Install the Kilo Code extension from the Marketplace

sixtySeconds.whatItDoes: Kilo Code is an AI coding agent that works in VS Code, JetBrains IDEs and the command line. It generates code across files from natural language, offers inline autocomplete, checks its own work, controls the terminal and browser, and has a marketplace for agents, skills, MCP servers and plugins. Built-in agents include Code, Plan, Ask and Debug.
sixtySeconds.problem: Gives you one coding agent across editor and terminal, with the freedom to switch models mid-task to balance speed, cost and reasoning.
sixtySeconds.whyChoose: Choose it for an MIT-licensed agent with many models, specialized modes and an autonomous mode for CI/CD.
requirements: VS Code, a JetBrains IDE, or a terminal
A Kilo account (for the extension's model access)

overview: In VS Code, install the Kilo Code extension and create an account for access to 500+ models. In JetBrains, install the Kilo Code plugin from the Marketplace. For the terminal, install the CLI and run kilo in a project.
Switch between Code, Plan, Ask and Debug agents, or build custom agents. The Kilo Marketplace adds skills, MCP servers and plugins.
kilo run --auto runs fully autonomously for CI pipelines and auto-approves prompts, so use it only in trusted environments. It is MIT licensed.
